I am a licensed Loan Officer and recently ran into an audit finding with UWM on a previous client. This part is information prior to my loan which I believe can be beneficial to the entire complaint. The audit team asked for documents and proof of the properties being rented to offset his XXXX so the outcome of his approval wouldn't change. About a week later they notified us that he has been black listed for undisclosed properties after the property had been sold and the loan paid in full. I relayed the information to him with their decision. It turns out that the other properties were with UWM as well through a different Loan officer in another state. UWM ( United Wholesale Mortgage ) systems for checks and balances should have triggered or caught this in my opinion. If all of his info is on each property how did UWM not catch thi s prior to them closing back to back? This shows severe issues in the UWM system process which puts the consumer at risk. Not to mention it puts UWM at risk as well. This is when things really started showing up at my door step. A few months later I needed to refinance my own property. I started to notice or feel that I was being targeted and wondered if I myself had been flagged due to the previous incident. In a nutshell I was pushed over to having a higher rate and payment do to negligence of the UWM team. We clearly know this is illegal and is a ploy for UWM to make more money with me being at a higher rate. At closing I signed the anti steering document as there was no steering by XXXX Mortgage, I feel confident that there was steering by the underwriters to push me into products that would have been more beneficial for the company. I will explain this further below as I explain the series of events. On another occasion the underwriter requested a CPA letter. I gladly reached out and copied the exact request from underwriting that I received from the processor and sent it over to my CPA. United Wholesale Mortgage is currently processing a loan application for a mutual client and we were provided a CPA explanation letter on your letterhead and bearing your signature. Your assistance is appreciated. Please feel free to reach out directly with any questions or concerns. It appears this was perfectly set up to try and entrap me and again to deny the loan. The font in the letter is slightly different. However, there is a repeated trend in how my account is being handled by UWM. This appears to be Overt Evidence and a violation of fair lending. Let 's move on to credit accounts with installments less than 10 months. UWM refused to make changes though statements proved that there were less than 10 months.
